name: vllm_gptq_gemm
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_gptq_gemm.py. GPTQ 4-bit GEMM on the use_exllama=True, use_v2_format=False path with bit=4, group_size=128: a (M,K) fp16; b_q_weight (K//8,N) int32 packing 8 int4 per word; b_gptq_qzeros (ceil((K//group_size)//8), N) int32; b_gptq_scales (K//group_size, N) fp16; b_g_idx (K,) int32 = arange//group_size. All tensors are interdependent / value-constrained so gen_inputs rebuilds them exactly as the test does (bit and group_size derived from shapes). Reference calls _custom_ops.gptq_gemm and returns the (M,N) result. The v2_format and other bit widths are not migrated. Requires vLLM at eval time.
